# PoiBlockOccupancyFilter Enumeration

> [!CAUTION]
> This enum is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Specifies how a block point-of-interest query filters instances by ticket occupancy.

## Constants
### **Any**
`Any = "Any"`

Includes POI instances regardless of their occupancy or available ticket count.
### **Full**
`Full = "Full"`

Includes POI instances with no available tickets.
### **HasVacancy**
`HasVacancy = "HasVacancy"`

Includes POI instances with at least one ticket available to be claimed.
